photos.why: Diagram 'Do not do this' of an erroneous reconstruction, not a faithful reconstruction of Dunkleosteus; shows a different-looking fish with fins.
Graph with shark silhouettes and violin plots, not a photo or reconstruction of the animal.
Museum display of a fossil skull with large bony jaw plates and blade-like tips, recognizable as Dunkleosteus.
Scientific two-panel figure with scale bars and dashed lines showing only a pelvic girdle, not the animal.
Dark fossil bone with a red arrow and small label; the scrape marks and the animal are barely recognizable.
Cast of a Dunkleosteus skull in a museum with the pointed bony jaw plate clearly visible.
Cast of a Dunkleosteus skull in a museum; the head and sharp bony jaw blades are clearly visible.
Close-up of a flat fossil bone fragment that does not clearly show the head or body of the species.
